arguments.context: Fix Intervals.icu OAuth integration in an existing app: Connect button fails for all athletes; one successful connection required reconnect after one hour. Need inspect local code and logs, fix causes, document in ANSWER.md.

arguments.text: Intervals.icu OAuth quirks — no refresh_token, Duplicate scope, and why the init endpoint must be POST. Init is authenticated POST returning authorize_url; scope each area once; callback verifies signed state; token endpoint fields client_id client_secret code; no synthetic expiry or refresh; mark disconnected on 401.
